tts: This program reads a temperature and decides which message to show. Only one of the three messages will print.
The comment says what the program does.
temp stores thirty-eight point six.
The if asks: is temp at least thirty-nine point five? Thirty-eight point six is not, so the condition is False. Python skips the indented line under it.
Now elif asks the next question: is temp at least thirty-eight? Yes. This condition is True.
So Python runs the block under elif, and prints Fever.
One block has already run, so Python skips else and the line under it.
The last line is not indented. It is outside the if chain, so it always runs.
